vocabulary.meaning: Mang đi, mang về (đồ ăn/thức uống)
Cà phê đã loại bỏ chất caffeine
Miếng bọc giấy quanh ly để chống nóng

dialogue.speaker: Barista
dialogue.text: Good morning! What can I get started for you today?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Hi, I need a large iced latte to go, please.

dialogue.speaker: Barista
dialogue.text: Sure, do you want regular espresso or decaf?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Regular, please. And can I also get a cardboard sleeve for the hot tea?

dialogue.speaker: Barista
dialogue.text: Of course, here is the sleeve so it doesn't burn your hand or spill.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Perfect, thank you. That is all for now.

story.text: A busy customer orders a large iced latte to go at the coffee shop. She prefers regular espresso over decaf. The barista hands her the drink along with a cardboard sleeve to prevent a hot spill on her way to work.

questions.question: Does the customer want to drink her coffee at the shop?
questions.suggested_answer: No, she orders it to go.

questions.question: What type of espresso does she choose?
questions.suggested_answer: She chooses regular espresso.

questions.question: Why does she request a cardboard sleeve?
questions.suggested_answer: She requests it so the drink does not burn her hand or spill.

questions.question: What type of drink is the latte?
questions.suggested_answer: It is a large iced latte.

vocabulary.meaning: Tình trạng sẵn có, còn trống
Sự trùng lịch, xung đột lịch trình
Khoảng thời gian, vị trí trống

dialogue.speaker: Staff A
dialogue.text: Hi, I need to check the availability of Meeting Room B for 2 PM today.

dialogue.speaker: Staff B
dialogue.text: Let me look at the calendar. Oh, there is a schedule conflict with the sales team.

dialogue.speaker: Staff A
dialogue.text: Is Room C free at that same time slot?

dialogue.speaker: Staff B
dialogue.text: Yes, Room C is completely open. Do you want me to reserve it for you?

dialogue.speaker: Staff A
dialogue.text: Yes, please. We need a working projector for our presentation.

dialogue.speaker: Staff B
dialogue.text: Done! The room has a high-quality projector ready.

story.text: An employee checks the availability of a meeting room for an afternoon presentation. Because Room B has a calendar conflict, he decides to reserve Room C instead. He chooses that specific slot because the team needs a working projector.

questions.question: What time slot does the employee want to book?
questions.suggested_answer: He wants to book a room for 2 PM today.

questions.question: Why can't he use Meeting Room B?
questions.suggested_answer: Because there is a schedule conflict with the sales team.

questions.question: Which room does he successfully reserve?
questions.suggested_answer: He successfully reserves Room C.

questions.question: What equipment does the team require inside the room?
questions.suggested_answer: They require a working projector.

vocabulary.meaning: Thẻ từ mở phòng, khóa thẻ
Giấy tờ tùy thân (CCCD, hộ chiếu)

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Welcome to the Oasis Resort. May I have your name and ID, please?

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.text: Hi, my name is John Smith. I have a reservation for a deluxe room.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Yes, Mr. Smith. Everything is set. Here is your electronic keycard for Room 405.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.text: Thank you. Is breakfast included in my stay?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Yes, we serve a complimentary breakfast buffet every morning near the lobby.

story.text: John Smith arrives at the Oasis Resort and presents his ID at the front desk. The receptionist verifies his deluxe room reservation and hands him an electronic keycard. She also points out the lobby area where guests enjoy a complimentary breakfast.

questions.question: What is the guest's name?
questions.suggested_answer: His name is John Smith.

questions.question: What must the guest provide to verify his identity?
questions.suggested_answer: He must provide his ID.

questions.question: What room number does the keycard open?
questions.suggested_answer: It opens Room 405.

questions.question: Where does the hotel serve the complimentary breakfast?
questions.suggested_answer: They serve it near the lobby.

vocabulary.meaning: Bác sĩ đo thị lực, chuyên viên khúc xạ

dialogue.speaker: Optometrist
dialogue.text: Please look at the chart on the wall. Is the bottom line blurry for you?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes, it is very blurry. I cannot distinguish the letters clearly.

dialogue.speaker: Optometrist
dialogue.text: Let me adjust the lens on this testing device. Is that better?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: Wow, yes! My vision becomes perfectly sharp now.

dialogue.speaker: Optometrist
dialogue.text: Great, you need a new prescription. You can go outside and pick a stylish frame.

story.text: A patient visits an optometrist because his vision feels blurry when reading. The doctor tests different types of lens options until the chart lines look sharp. Finally, the patient prepares to choose a brand new glasses frame.

questions.question: Who does the patient visit for his eyes?
questions.suggested_answer: He visits an optometrist.

questions.question: Why does he need an exam?
questions.suggested_answer: Because his vision feels blurry.

questions.question: How does the doctor fix the blurriness during the test?
questions.suggested_answer: The doctor adjusts the testing lens.

questions.question: What can the patient choose after the exam?
questions.suggested_answer: He can choose a stylish frame.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.text: Look at the balcony, the green leaves on the rosebush start to wilt.

dialogue.speaker: Son
dialogue.text: Oh, the soil looks completely dry. Should I get the watering can?

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.text: Yes, please. Give them enough water, but be careful not to overwater them.

dialogue.speaker: Son
dialogue.text: How do I know if the moisture level is right?

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.text: Just touch the surface. Look, some tiny seeds finally sprout over here too!

story.text: A boy notices that his balcony leaves wilt because the soil lacks moisture. His mother tells him to use the watering can but warns him not to overwater the roots. Together, they smile when they see new seeds sprout in the corner.

questions.question: What happens to the rosebush leaves?
questions.suggested_answer: They start to wilt.

questions.question: What is the condition of the soil before watering?
questions.suggested_answer: The soil looks completely dry.

questions.question: What warning does the mother give?
questions.suggested_answer: She warns her son not to overwater the plants.

questions.question: What exciting change happens in the corner of the garden?
questions.suggested_answer: Some tiny seeds finally sprout.

vocabulary.meaning: Tính cả tôi vào nhé, tôi tham gia với
Chủ nhà, chủ tiệc / Đứng ra tổ chức
Bữa tiệc góp vui (mỗi người tự mang một món)

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Hey Tom, I am hosting a small weekend gathering at my apartment. Are you free?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: That sounds fun! What kind of gathering is it?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: It is a casual potluck. Everyone brings their favorite homemade dish.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Awesome, count me in! I will bring my famous pasta salad.

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Wonderful! I will send you the formal digital invitation with the address details later.

story.text: Alice acts as the host for a casual weekend gathering at her place. She extends an invitation to Tom for a friendly potluck. Tom immediately says 'count me in' and promises to cook his favorite pasta salad for everyone.

questions.question: Who is hosting the weekend gathering?
questions.suggested_answer: Alice is hosting the weekend gathering.

questions.question: What style of party is it?
questions.suggested_answer: It is a casual potluck.

questions.question: What phrase does Tom use to accept the invitation?
questions.suggested_answer: He says 'count me in'.

questions.question: What dish does Tom offer to bring?
questions.suggested_answer: He offers to bring his famous pasta salad.

vocabulary.meaning: Vết xước, lỗi nhỏ, khuyết điểm

dialogue.speaker: Shopper
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I like this wooden coffee table, but I notice a small flaw on the leg.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Oh, let me see. Yes, it has a tiny scratch. It is the last one in our display store.

dialogue.speaker: Shopper
dialogue.text: Can you offer a small discount because of this visual damage?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: I need to consult my manager about a price reduction. Please wait a moment.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Good news! My manager agrees to give you a ten percent reduction.

dialogue.speaker: Shopper
dialogue.text: Great, that is a fair bargain. I will take it.

story.text: A shopper notices a minor flaw on a wooden coffee table leg. She asks the clerk if she can bargain for a discount since it is the last display model. The clerk talks to the manager and secures a ten percent price reduction.

questions.question: What product is the shopper examining?
questions.suggested_answer: She is examining a wooden coffee table.

questions.question: What is wrong with the furniture item?
questions.suggested_answer: It has a small flaw (a scratch) on the leg.

questions.question: Who must approve the price reduction?
questions.suggested_answer: The store manager must approve it.

questions.question: How much is the final approved discount?
questions.suggested_answer: The approved discount is ten percent.

vocabulary.meaning: Mời ai đó, bao ăn / Chấu đãi

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.text: That dinner is delicious! Let's ask the waiter for the final bill.

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.text: Here it comes. The total amount is eighty dollars. Let's split it evenly.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.text: No, let me treat you tonight! It is your birthday week, after all.

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.text: That is sweet, but we always share expenses. Let me calculate my exact part.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.text: Alright, if you insist, we can split the bill fifty-fifty.

story.text: Two friends finish a delicious dinner and receive the total bill from the waiter. Friend A offers to treat because it is a birthday week, but Friend B prefers to calculate and share the cost. They eventually decide to split the amount fifty-fifty.

questions.question: What is the total cost on the bill?
questions.suggested_answer: The total cost is eighty dollars.

questions.question: Why does Friend A offer to treat?
questions.suggested_answer: Because it is Friend B's birthday week.

questions.question: What does Friend B prefer to do instead?
questions.suggested_answer: Friend B prefers to calculate and share the expense.

questions.question: What is their final agreement on paying?
questions.suggested_answer: They agree to split the bill fifty-fifty.

vocabulary.meaning: Nộp, đệ trình (báo cáo, tài liệu)

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.text: Team, the client needs the project report by 5 PM today. It is highly urgent.

dialogue.speaker: Developer
dialogue.text: But we still have some minor bugs to fix. Can we postpone the delivery until tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.text: Unfortunately, no. We cannot miss this deadline. Everyone needs to focus.

dialogue.speaker: Developer
dialogue.text: Okay, I see. I will work overtime during lunch to complete the coding.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.text: Thank you. Let's finish strong and submit the file on time.

story.text: A project manager announces an urgent deadline to her technical team. The client wants the final report today, so they cannot postpone the delivery. A developer agrees to work overtime to fix bugs and submit everything on schedule.

questions.question: When does the client require the final project report?
questions.suggested_answer: The client requires it by 5 PM today.

questions.question: Why is the task critical?
questions.suggested_answer: Because it is an urgent deadline that they cannot miss.

questions.question: Can the team postpone the submission until tomorrow?
questions.suggested_answer: No, they cannot postpone it.

questions.question: What sacrifice does the developer make?
questions.suggested_answer: He agrees to work overtime during his lunch break.

vocabulary.meaning: An ninh, bộ phận an ninh
Khay nhựa đựng đồ qua máy quét
Cởi bỏ, tháo ra, bỏ ra

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Please prepare for the security check. Place your electronic items in a separate bin.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.text: Should I take out my laptop and my water bottle?

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Yes, remove your laptop. However, no large liquid containers are allowed through here.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.text: Oh, I understand, I will throw the water away. Do I need to take off my jacket?

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Yes, please remove your jacket, shoes, and leather belt as well.

story.text: A traveler goes through the airport security checkpoint before his flight. An officer instructs him to put his laptop in a separate plastic bin. The traveler removes his heavy jacket and leather belt, and discards a restricted liquid bottle.

questions.question: Where does this check take place?
questions.suggested_answer: It takes place at the airport security checkpoint.

questions.question: Where should the laptop be placed?
questions.suggested_answer: It should be placed in a separate bin.

questions.question: Why must the traveler throw his water bottle away?
questions.suggested_answer: Because large liquid containers are not allowed through security.

questions.question: What personal items does the traveler need to take off?
questions.suggested_answer: He needs to remove his jacket, shoes, and leather belt.
